super_account_admin_name.description: The name of the super (admin) account. Null when no super account is configured.

i18n.zh-Hans: 高权限（管理员）账号的名称。未配置高权限账号时为 null。
i18n.en-US: The name of the super (admin) account. Null when no super account is configured.

super_account_three_roles.description: Whether three-role rights separation (admin/security/audit) is enabled on the instance. Null when no super account is configured.

i18n.zh-Hans: 实例上是否已启用三权分立（管理员/安全管理员/审计员）。未配置高权限账号时为 null。
i18n.en-US: Whether three-role rights separation (admin/security/audit) is enabled on the instance. Null when no super account is configured.
